description.zh: 把平面点写成复数后，乘以单位模复数可以表示旋转；实部和虚部给出两个坐标。
description.en: Represent a plane point as a complex number. Multiplication by a unit-magnitude complex number rotates it; real and imaginary parts are coordinates.

complex.formula: z = cos θ + i sin θ

reason.zh: 无阻尼、无持续外力驱动（回复力仍存在）的理想弹簧振子满足 x″ + (k/m)x = 0，其解为正弦和余弦的组合。
reason.en: An ideal spring without damping or sustained driving, with its restoring force still present, obeys x″ + (k/m)x = 0, whose solutions combine sine and cosine.
